claim: The canonical dataset contains 45 buildings, 36 eligible buildings and 630 unordered two-building candidates.
allowed_wording: The enumerator exhaustively screened the defined 630 candidate universe.
forbidden_wording: The AI found the globally optimal real-world design.
notes: The universe is complete only under the declared eligibility and two-building intervention rules.

claim: The 2.5D ranking was strongly aligned with HB-Radiance on the frozen 20-pair independent sample.
allowed_wording: Within the frozen sample, rank agreement was high.
forbidden_wording: The proxy is universally accurate for arbitrary geometries.
notes: Do not generalize beyond the declared geometry family and sample.

claim: HB-Radiance was used as a curated high-fidelity validation layer rather than for all 630 candidates.
allowed_wording: The workflow uses exhaustive low-cost screening plus selective high-fidelity verification.
notes: The full-630 HB time is an extrapolation only.

claim: The C9,C15 design translation improved the target metric without observed new low-sun area or worsened points in the rerun.
allowed_wording: In this rerun and metric definition, no adverse point or new low-area signal was observed.
forbidden_wording: C9,C15 is universally safe or optimal.
notes: Still requires architectural and site review.

claim: The C9,C24 design translation is a high-gain but review-required candidate because adverse point-level changes and new low-sun area remain.
allowed_wording: Report it as a trade-off candidate, not an automatic recommendation.
forbidden_wording: The algorithm produced a final answer that needs no review.
notes: The judgment ledger is intentionally human-in-the-loop.

claim: The method is rule-based computational screening, not a trained machine-learning model.
allowed_wording: Describe it as a computational decision-support workflow.
forbidden_wording: The system learned a black-box model or replaced designers.
notes: No training set or learned weights are claimed.

claim: Human review is required for geometry correspondence, design translation, and final architectural acceptance.
allowed_wording: Use the system as an auditable assistant.
forbidden_wording: The numerical result alone proves buildability or heritage compliance.
